name: Rank Progress S.A.
summary: Rank Progress S.A. is a real estate firm specializing in the investment, development, leasing, and sale of commercial properties. Operating both in Poland and internationally, the company constructs a diverse range of projects, including shopping centers, retail malls, residential buildings, service establishments, and office complexes. Established in 1997, Rank Progress S.A. is headquartered in Legnica, Poland.
